commands: echo "GITHUB_ACTIONS=$GITHUB_ACTIONS"; echo "ISSUE=1425"; git branch --show-current; git status --porcelain | head; echo "---extension dir---"; echo "${CLAUDE_SKILL_DIR:-unset}"
echo "GITHUB_ACTIONS=$GITHUB_ACTIONS"; git branch --show-current; git status --porcelain | head
printf 'GHA:%s\n' "$GITHUB_ACTIONS"; git branch --show-current; git status --porcelain | head

git checkout -b issue-1425-chore-skills-editorially-compress-the-review 2>&1
mkdir -p .prflow/tmp/issue-body
gh issue view 1425 --json body --jq '.body' > .prflow/tmp/issue-body/issue-1425.md
scripts/parse-acs.py --body-file .prflow/tmp/issue-body/issue-1425.md > .prflow/tmp/acs-1425.md 2>&1
echo "---ACS---"
cat .prflow/tmp/acs-1425.md

python3 .prflow/tmp/tripwire.py diff 2>&1 | grep phase-0-setup; echo "=== frozen literals in phase-0-setup ==="; for lit in "CURRENT_BRANCH_BASE_CAPTURE" "config_only" "engine_self_modifying" "head_override" "# BEGIN HEAD_OVERRIDE_BASE_RESOLUTION" "# END HEAD_OVERRIDE_BASE_RESOLUTION" "# BEGIN CURRENT_BRANCH_BASE_CAPTURE" "# Render <resolved-local-diff-base>" "checklist_skipped = \"intentional\"" "pruned-path-ok: cli/cli#5398"; do printf '%s => ' "$lit"; grep -cF "$lit" skills/review/phases/phas …[per-command-truncated]

cd /home/runner/work/prflow/prflow; . lib/render-report.sh; SUM='{"prs_scanned":8,"clean_count":3,"analyzed_count":5,"intervention_issues":[{"tag":"implement-review-miss","url":"https://x/issues/901"}],"cooldown_skipped":["doc-inventory-inaccuracy"],"blockers":[],"state_pr":900}'; REPORT="$(devflow_render_report "$SUM")"; printf '%s\n' "$REPORT" | head -8; echo "=== grep 8 rc ==="; printf '%s' "$REPORT" | grep -q '8' && echo "PASS: contains 8" || echo "FAIL: no 8"
for f in phase-0-3-6-blocker-recheck phase-0-6-stale-prose-lint phase-2-verification; do echo "===== $f ====="; git diff main...HEAD -- skills/review/phases/$f.md | wc -l; done

git diff main...HEAD -- skills/review/phases/phase-0-3-6-blocker-recheck.md > /tmp/d1.txt; git diff main...HEAD -- skills/review/phases/phase-0-6-stale-prose-lint.md > /tmp/d2.txt; git diff main...HEAD -- skills/review/phases/phase-2-verification.md > /tmp/d3.txt; wc -l /tmp/d1.txt /tmp/d2.txt /tmp/d3.txt
scripts/checkout-fingerprint.py 2>&1 | head; echo "=== reception candidate identity ==="; scripts/reception-record.py record --help 2>&1 | head -30

python3 .prflow/tmp/tripwire.py diff 2>&1 | tail -5; echo "=== did MERGE_HEAD change my phase files vs merge-base? ==="; git merge-base HEAD MERGE_HEAD 2>&1; MB=$(git merge-base HEAD MERGE_HEAD); git diff --name-only "$MB" MERGE_HEAD -- skills/review/phases/ 2>&1 || echo "none"
MB=$(git merge-base HEAD MERGE_HEAD); echo "merge-base $MB"; git diff --name-only "$MB" MERGE_HEAD -- skills/review/phases/ 2>&1 | head || echo "main touched NO phase files"
